Troubleshooting · 33/50 · conform

EDL reel-name mismatch

Failure signal

A edl reel-name mismatch condition is reported or detected during conform.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for conform does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare EDL reel identifiers with source metadata and the ingest naming map.

Corrective action

Apply a reviewed translation map and test every ambiguous event manually.

Prevention

Add this verification to the conform gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
